pulse.currentFocus: S195 /goal chain (broad expansion audit → 12/13 shipped, 1 deferred · build:check EXIT 0). Plus First-Climb quest, theme identity cue, /security/ trust-posture deepen (verdict+uptime), onboarding-arc gtag→/v/rum rewire, nav-sheet kill-switch+50% canary, INP field gate, sitewide BreadcrumbList (29 pages+gate). Two escalation-class remainders (theme tier-lock, nav-sheet 100% flip) flagged for founder.
